newsitem.title: USA: Einstein/Noah target of holder suit.
newsitem.headline: Einstein/Noah target of holder suit.

text.p: Buyers of the common stock of Einstein Noah Bagel Corp filed a class action lawsuit against the bagel retailer, lawyers for the plaintiffs said Monday.
The law firm of Cohen, Milstein, Hausfeld & Toll said the stockholders lawsuit charged Einstein and some of its officers and directors with violating federal securities laws.
Company officials could not be reached immediately.
A statement issued by the law firm did not indicate the court in which the lawsuit was filed. The attorneys could not be reached immediately.

The suit alleged that the company "failed to recognize in Einstein's financial statements substantial losses that were being incurred through retail outlets that were under the control of Einstein," the law firm said.
The plaintiffs alleged that the company raised $81 million in a 1996 initial public offering at $17 per share, and then "drove the share price to even higher levels in late 1996."
The lawyers said the lawsuit was brought by individuals who bought Einstein stock between Aug. 2, 1996 and July 25, 1997.
Another shareholder lawsuit was brought aganst the company last month in U.S. District Court in Colorado, also alleging violations of of federal securities laws.
